title: Different behavior between `Window::set_hdr_output_requested` and `DS::window_request_hdr_output`
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7 Beta 2

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta2 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8108) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads) - 63.74 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When the `display/window/hdr/request_hdr_output` project setting is turned on, a very helpful warning is logged when HDR 2D is off:

> WARNING: editor/editor_node.cpp:564 - HDR 2D was automatically enabled because HDR output was requested in project settings. To avoid this warning, enable rendering/viewport/hdr_2d in the Project Settings.

But if you create an in-game settings menu in an existing game that allows the player to request HDR output without using the project setting, you will not receive any warning that HDR 2D will be forcefully enabled on the Window's main Viewport.

Also, as pointed out in the comments of this issue, there are other, more severe issues that are caused by this inconsistency between `Window::set_hdr_output_requested(bool p_requested)` and `DisplayServer::window_request_hdr_output(const bool p_enable, DisplayServerEnums::WindowID p_window)`: When I'm working with a project that has HDR 2D disabled, I get different behaviour when I enable "Request HDR Output" on the game view than if I enabled "Request HDR Output" through the project settings.

### Proposed solution

When `Window.hdr_output_requested` is set to `true` on a Window whose main `Viewport.use_hdr_2d` is `false`, the following warning should be logged:

> HDR 2D was automatically enabled because HDR output was requested. This will produce inconsistent appearance between SDR and HDR output modes. To resolve this issue, set use_hdr_2d to always be true on this Window, regardless of the hdr_output_requested property.

This warning is slightly different than the project settings warning because the appearance between SDR mode and HDR mode is consistent with a given project settings configuration. Changing `Window.hdr_output_requested` at runtime is different because it can have a dramatic change in appearance between SDR and HDR modes if HDR 2D is disabled.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a project with default project settings (HDR 2D off)
2. Set `Window.hdr_output_requested` to `true` through an in-game setting (or via the game view's toolbar window options PopupMenu)
3. No warning is logged about HDR 2D being forcefully enabled on the Window's main Viewport

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
